central_thesis: Expensya abandoned English-language global product positioning to claim French-market category leadership through native-language problem framing, replacing 'Automated spend management for all companies' with 'Voici à quoi devrait ressembler la gestion des dépenses' and removing company-size segmentation navigation in favor of French-language commercial contact flows.
old_positioning_frame: Universal automation product for any company size, emphasizing process digitization ('paperless invoices to reimbursement') and feature completeness across small/mid/large segments
new_positioning_frame: Prescriptive category vision for French-speaking finance teams, emphasizing outcome transformation ('stress et frictions' replaced by 'clarté et simplicité') and card-based spend control rather than expense automation
buyer_shift: English-speaking decision-makers across company sizes evaluating expense automation features → French-speaking finance leaders ('équipes financières modernes') seeking integrated card and policy infrastructure
funnel_shift: Early exploration stage (free trial, 'discover solutions', company size selection) → Late-stage commercial engagement (sales contact, demo booking, existing user login)

main_evidence.old: Automated spend management for all companies
main_evidence.new: Voici à quoi devrait ressembler la gestion des dépenses.
main_evidence.meaning: Suggests a shift from product description to prescriptive category definition—'this is what it should look like' signals market authority rather than feature comparison. The language switch from English to French indicates deliberate geographic market prioritization rather than translation alone.

main_evidence.old: From paperless invoices to reimbursement, Expensya software and mobile app automate every step of the spend management and expense reporting process.
main_evidence.new: Remplacez le stress et les frictions liés à la gestion des dépenses et des notes de frais des employés par la clarté et la simplicité : voici Expensya, le logiciel intelligent de gestion des dépenses pour les équipes financières modernes.
main_evidence.meaning: Points to a repositioning from process efficiency (step automation) to emotional outcome ('stress et frictions' → 'clarté et simplicité'). The addition of 'équipes financières modernes' buyer persona is consistent with upmarket positioning away from 'all companies'.

main_evidence.old: Small · Mid · Large · Features · Self-managed expenses · Secure dematerialization · Intelligent validation and control
main_evidence.new: En savoir plus · Se connecter · Contacter un commercial · Expensya · Anglais · Solutions · Aperçu · Application mobile
main_evidence.meaning: Signals abandonment of company-size self-segmentation in favor of sales-led qualification ('Contacter un commercial'). The presence of 'Se connecter' (login) suggests existing customer base maturity. Removal of feature-level navigation may indicate confidence that buyers already understand the category.

main_evidence.old: Expensya fully automates your business expenditure · A solution designed for every company · Features designed to transform your expense management
main_evidence.new: Cartes de paiement & budgets · Politiques de dépenses · Multi-devises et multi-pays · Comment gérez-vous vos notes de frais ? · Fini le casse-tête administratif, place à la conformité.
main_evidence.meaning: Is consistent with product expansion from expense reporting to card issuance and policy enforcement infrastructure. 'Conformité' emphasis suggests regulatory differentiation or CFO-level risk concerns rather than employee convenience.

main_evidence.old: Free trial · Discover our solutions · Find out more · Discover all integrations
main_evidence.new: Réservez une démo (added) · Learn more about this provider (cookie consent artifact)
main_evidence.meaning: Suggests shift from self-service trial to demo-qualified pipeline. The removal of 'Free trial' and 'Discover all integrations' may indicate higher ACV target customers requiring implementation support rather than plug-and-play adoption.

copy_this_if: Your company name is already recognized by finance teams in your target geography when searching for your product category, and you have substantive product differentiation (like card issuance or multi-entity support) beyond core expense workflow automation that justifies abandoning comparison traffic.
do_not_copy_this_if: You rely on organic English-language search traffic for category education, or your primary differentiation is implementation speed/ease rather than financial control depth, or you lack the sales infrastructure to qualify and close demo-driven pipeline at scale.
safer_version_for_early_stage_saas: Test a French-language landing page variant targeting 'équipes financières' with demo CTA while maintaining English comparison-optimized homepage, measuring whether qualified demo volume offsets trial signup reduction before committing to full language pivot.
risk_if_copied: Immediate loss of English-language organic acquisition traffic if you lack brand recognition in French-speaking markets, forcing dependency on paid acquisition or sales outbound without the pipeline volume to support CAC payback, particularly if your product lacks the card/policy infrastructure that justifies sales-led motion.
